title: Concept: Strict-Transport-Security max-age is not a valid delta-seconds value
description: Strict-Transport-Security carries a max-age directive that is not a plain unsigned integer. Parsers reject the directive, and HSTS processing stops for the whole header, so the origin loses the protection the header was meant to establish: the next plaintext navigation is not upgraded and the browser records no HSTS state.
risk: No HSTS enforcement despite an HSTS header being present; MEDIUM severity, matching a missing policy.
